intentional_exclusions: SBOM, advisory, license, and source-list exports
temporary build targets and cloned dependency trees
credentials, access tokens, private keys, ciphertext, message content, and live Matrix state

authorized_recapture.location: an access-controlled disposable worktree outside Git
procedure: checkout the exact retained source revisions and verify tag objects, peeled commits, registry checksums, and dependency locks
materialize the approved common harness aggregate and each candidate source in the access-controlled worktree
run the listed commands with a new isolated target and no production credentials or live state
persist machine-readable stdout, metadata, dependency, advisory, license, and result receipts only in the access-controlled evidence area
redact and reject any receipt containing credentials, private keys, ciphertext, message content, database pages, or live identifiers
compare retained receipt hashes and explain every mismatch; never overwrite the historical receipt
publish only a new sanitized hash index after independent semantic review and deterministic verification
